reviews.x: Bergman Kelly's exfoliating loofahs are a good and nice product. However, this loofah does not scratch deep like I like. The long loofah has to be ringed out if let wet it will stink.

reviews.t: A nice loofah. Cleans well without being harsh
reviews.x: A nice loofah. Cleans well without being harsh, I use them daily and they are still in good condition months later.
I love it in my shower. I get soapy and scrub myself down, rinse and leave the shower feeling like a new person.
There is no "scrub" to the loofas and 1 of the suction cups is warped and will not stick to the wall.
For the price, a nice purchase. Scrubbing area a bit on the small side, but does the job removing dead skin.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the back scrubbers effective for reaching and exfoliating hard-to-reach areas of the back.
Several reviewers praise the quality and value of the set, including the packaging and bundling of sizes.
Some reviewers report durability problems, with the loofahs splitting or breaking quickly.
A few reviewers complain about a strong unpleasant smell that persists even after soaking.
Some reviewers note issues with the suction cups not staying stuck to the wall.
